items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, during the twenties, did people like Baby Dodds or Zotty Singleton... [INTERVIEWEE] No, we didn't have much truck with the colored people.

ctx.x: Well at the Alamac Hotel, we didn't have very many subs, unless some guy was sick. And there would be a sub come in and everybody didn't like him because he didn't like the band sound like it should have sounded, you know. So that's that story.
Well, during the twenties, did people like Baby Dodds or Zotty Singleton...
No, we didn't have much truck with the colored people.
